meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 给指定的 NanoClaw 代理组装好无密钥的 Tavily 远程 MCP 工具,代理可用 tavily_search 联网搜索、tavily_extract 抓取网页;额度用尽时,代理会引导用户通过 OneCLI 链接升级为付费密钥。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 代理组安装无需 API 密钥的 Tavily 网页搜索或网址提取功能时。

say.text: 给团队 A 组装无密钥的 Tavily 搜索和网页提取工具。
say.note: 会安装桥接并注册 tavily 服务。

say.text: 帮我把 Tavily 装到本地开发组,不要 API key。
say.note: 会走无密钥远程 MCP 配置。

say.text: Tavily 额度用完了,帮我走升级流程。
say.note: 会引导用 OneCLI 链接存密钥。

howto.what_en: Adds keyless Tavily remote MCP tools (tavily_search, tavily_extract) to selected NanoClaw agent groups via the mcp-remote bridge, so agents can search the web and extract URLs without an API key. When the keyless allowance runs out, the agent guides the user through a paid-key upgrade via OneCLI.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction for NanoClaw agent groups without an API key. It triggers on a request to set up Tavily tools keylessly for one or more selected groups.

say_en.text: Install keyless Tavily search and extract tools for team A.
say_en.note: It installs the bridge and registers the tavily service.

say_en.text: Set up Tavily for the local dev group without an API key.
say_en.note: Uses the keyless remote MCP configuration.

say_en.text: Tavily quota is used up; help me run the upgrade flow.
say_en.note: Guides you to store a key via the OneCLI link.
